chapters.title: Two rows
chapters.code:
def is_interleave(s1, s2, s3):
    m, n = len(s1), len(s2)
    if m + n != len(s3):
        return False
    prev = None
    for i in range(m + 1):
        cur = [False] * (n + 1)
        for j in range(n + 1):
            if i == 0 and j == 0:
                cur[0] = True
                continue
            k = i + j - 1
            from_s1 = i > 0 and prev[j] and s1[i - 1] == s3[k]
            from_s2 = j > 0 and cur[j - 1] and s2[j - 1] == s3[k]
            cur[j] = from_s1 or from_s2
        prev = cur
    return prev[n]
